Current project instructions require reporting playback failure with the task ID, browser/error state, and whether another clip plays. A visible waveform without playback is still a technical issue, not evidence of silence; unavailable playback alone does not justify a model-quality failure or content-based QN. Any separate content concern from accessible evidence should be retained for review. The earlier batch had an approved, posted trial allowing at most one reload for a player stuck at 00:00, limited to that batch and ending August 28. The historical follow-up records playback starting after two of six reload attempts and remaining stuck after four. It concludes that the trial did not provide a dependable general workaround and that the authorization was not extended into a later queue; it did not establish a common cause. An old workaround must be checked against current symptoms. Recurrence alone does not establish which fix was tried or why it failed, and handling guidance does not establish that playback has been repaired or that an affected task can be evaluated.
